# Moves catalogue (generated by scripts/gallery.mjs, do not edit)

Pick a category for what the speaker is saying, then read only that file in catalog/ (two at most
per beat). Open a move's own files only for the 1-2 moves being rendered. Never read gallery.html
or every move.json.

- catalog/social.md | 28 moves | posts, comments, DMs, follows, stories, polls, reactions, testimonials
- catalog/creator.md | 27 moves | videos, channels, editing tools, captions, thumbnails, chapters, podcasts, list numbers
- catalog/ai.md | 23 moves | agents, prompts, models, AI answers, memory, automations, connectors
- catalog/dev.md | 19 moves | code, terminal, pull requests, deploys, APIs, logs, status pages, sites and domains
- catalog/productivity.md | 27 moves | docs, email, calendar, tasks, files, meetings, search, timers
- catalog/business.md | 30 moves | deals, invoices, payments, pricing, carts and orders, hiring, bookings, products
- catalog/data.md | 35 moves | charts, stats, rankings, growth, comparisons by number, maps
- catalog/paper.md | 29 moves | physical documents: clippings, letters, receipts, stamps, certificates, print, books
- catalog/system.md | 22 moves | phone and desktop OS: notifications, dialogs, codes, windows, settings, shortcuts
- catalog/explain.md | 26 moves | breaking an idea down: parts, steps, lists, frameworks, pros and cons, verdicts, pointing at things
